key_insight: Correct clinical AI answers can mask invalid reasoning, motivating step-level evaluation and symbolic constraints rather than accuracy checks alone.
clinical_relevance: Auditing reasoning trajectories may help identify hallucinations, causal errors, and demographic shortcuts that conventional clinical AI benchmarks miss.
method: Critically reviews clinical hallucination and error propagation in agentic systems.
Examines process reward models and neuro-symbolic grounding.
Proposes mapping agentic failure modes to symbolic intervention points.
evidence_signal: Reported safety gains come from individual studies, mostly using simulations or small samples, and are not directly comparable with neural baselines.
watch_item: Symbolic guarantees apply only within encoded knowledge domains, so they do not establish general clinical safety.
paper_title: Verifiable Logic in Medical LLMs: A Critical Review of Agentic Clinical Reasoning Optimization and Neuro-Symbolic Grounding
